Market today: The mood is mixed for tech/chips. Rising Treasury yields are a potential headwind, but strong demand for chips (SpaceX) and positive technicals (Meta) are providing support.

Your holdings: SOXL (-26.91%) and SPAL (-12.64%) are flagged "SELL" and "WATCH" respectively, both leveraged and showing significant losses. MUU (-5.51%) is another leveraged position with a notable drawdown. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields, as their continued rise could pressure your growth-heavy portfolio. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively and respect your stops, while selectively looking for strength in core chip names.
plays: Trim SOXL (-26.91%) given its 'SELL' status and leveraged decay. Respect SPAL's stop at 21.38 to manage further downside on this leveraged position.
Consider AMD for new chip exposure, aligning with strong demand. Scanner entry 648.77-648.12, stop 647.15.
